lessonPlan.description: In this lesson, you'll learn how to order food in a restaurant.
lessonPlan.title: 在餐馆点菜

activity.instructions: 翻转卡片，获取更多信息。

flashcards.definition: a large cut of beef cooked and served with a whole potato which has been baked in an oven.
examples: Jeff ordered a steak and baked potato at the restaurant last night.
I'll have a steak and baked potato.

flashcards.definition: a soup, usually cream-based, containing mushrooms
examples: This restaurant is famous for its mushroom soup. You have to try it!

flashcards.definition: a large salad consisting of lettuce, tomato and other vegetables with slices of cheese and meat such as chicken on top
a large fish with silver skin and pink flesh that is used for food and is caught, not raised commercially
examples: He prefers to eat wild salmon.

flashcards.definition: potatoes that are cut into long, thin strips and fried
examples: French fries are best when they are hot and salty.

flashcards.definition: cream which has deliberately been made sour, served in a small container on the side of the main dish in a meal
examples: Could I have the sour cream on the side, please?
more sour cream on the side

flashcards.definition: a drinking glass filled with brewed tea over ice
examples: Nothing is better on a hot summer day than a glass of iced tea!
a freshly brewed glass of iced tea

flashcards.definition: a creamy salad dressing made with blue cheese
examples: Would you like blue cheese dressing on your salad?

activity.title: 8ba80648-c38c-47e3-bb16-4d4af899eb70

body.text:
没有两份菜单是一样的，但绝大多数被分为几个成分，诸如**starters**, **main courses** 和**desserts**。识别这些成分和知道在它们中要寻找什么会使得餐单更容易认读。  
**Starters**, 或**appetizers**通常出现在菜单的开头。这部分也许包括诸如**soups** and **salads**的小部分。

items.phrase:
您要开胃菜吗？  
奶酪开胃菜听起来真的不错。
items.targetPhrase:
A: Would you like a **starter**?  
B: The **cheese appetizer** sounds really good.

body.text: 下一环节通常是**main courses**, 或 **entrees**。 **Entree**是一个法语词。听听该词的发音。

items.phrase:
您决定好要点什么主菜了吗？  
鸡肉主菜配有米饭吗？
items.targetPhrase:
A: Have you decided on your **main course**?  
B: Does the **chicken entree** come with rice?

body.text: 主菜通常会是淀粉食物和蔬菜搭配在一起，如大米和胡萝卜。您也许会在菜单上看到：**comes with** 或**served with**。

items.phrase: 牛排搭配土豆泥和青豆。
items.targetPhrase: The steak is **served with** mashed potatoes and peas.
The fish **comes with** rice and beans.

body.text: 如果您想要一份额外的食物，如薯条或蔬菜，来和您的主食一起吃或分享，那么您可以点一份 **side dish**.

items.phrase: 我们给桌上的每个人再来点配菜吧。
items.targetPhrase: Let's get some extra **side dishes** for everybody at the table.

body.text: **Desserts**通常放在菜单的末尾，许多**Desserts**是根据它们的原产国而得名的。听听以下**Desserts**的发音。

items.targetPhrase: tiramisu
chocolate mousse
lemon sorbet

tasks.prompt: How many starters does the restaurant serve?
What is the most expensive main course?
How much is the shrimp cocktail?
What is served with vanilla ice cream?

body.text:
**可数名词和不可数名词的量词**  
  
记住，大多数名词都是可数的，比如 **apple** 和 **steak**。这些可数名词都有复数形式，词尾通常是 **s**。

items.targetPhrase: one apple, two apple**s**

body.text: 有些名词不能这样计数，比如 **soup** 和 **milk**。要加以计数，你必须添加像 **a cup of** 或 **two liters of** 这样的短语。

items.targetPhrase: **a cup of** soup, **two cups of** soup

body.text: 大多数量词要么与可数名词搭配使用，要么与不可数名词搭配使用。**A lot of** 是一个例外。你可以用它搭配可数和不可数名词，谈论某物非常大的数量。

items.phrase: 花园沙拉里有许多西红柿。
items.targetPhrase: The garden salad has **a lot of tomatoes.**
Is there **a lot of bacon** in the soup?

body.text:
**搭配可数名词的量词**  
  
使用 **a few** 搭配可数名词，谈论数量很少的东西。

items.targetPhrase: I can only eat **a few oysters.**

body.text: 使用 **many** 搭配可数名词的复数形式，谈论很大的数量，或与否定形式连用，谈论很少的数量。

items.phrase: 他们有许多不同种类的冰淇淋。
items.targetPhrase: They have **many different kinds of ice cream.**

items.phrase: 这份水果沙拉里面草莓很少。
items.targetPhrase: There **aren't many strawberries** in this fruit salad.

body.text: 使用 **how many** 询问可数名词的数量。

items.targetPhrase: **How many sausages** would you like?

body.text:
**搭配不可数名词的量词**  
  
使用 **a little** 搭配不可数名词，谈论数量很少的东西。

items.targetPhrase: The soup has **a little sour cream** on top.
Would you like **a little milk** with your coffee?

body.text: 在否定陈述句中使用 **much** 搭配不可数名词，谈论很少的数量。

items.phrase: 我不要太多牛奶，请放一点点。
items.targetPhrase: **I don't want much milk.** Just a little, please.

body.text: 使用 **how much** 询问不可数名词的数量。

items.targetPhrase: **How much bread** would you like?

activity.instructions: 听两个人做好准备去买食物。

audio.transcript: Do we need any milk? No, we have a lot of milk. How about eggs? Uh, we only have a few eggs. And we only have a little bread. What else do we need? Well, we don't have much orange juice. And we need fruit. We don't have many apples and bananas. Okay, great.

activity.instructions: 听一位顾客在餐馆点菜。

audio.transcript: What can I get you? Um, could I have the Caesar salad to start? Certainly. And for your main course? Does the chicken come with any vegetables? Yes, it does. It comes with peas and carrots. Great. I'll have the chicken, please. Would you like french fries or a baked potato with that? I'd like the french fries. And what would you like to drink? A cup of coffee, please. And would you like to order dessert now? No, I'll wait. Thank you.
